d: Raghopur pul ka nam 'nitish setu' rakhe jane ko lekar rashtriy janta dal (RJD) pramukh lalu prasad yadav ki beti rohini aachary dvara uthae gae savalon par bihar ke mukhyamantri samrat chaudhri ne patna men apni pratikriya di hai. midiya se batchit karte hue mukhyamantri samrat chaudhri ne is pariyojna ki shuruaat se lekar shilanyas tak ki jankari sajha ki.
